threads.Author: claude
threads.Text: [B] Weakest decision in the plan: markers.max 1 for plans contradicts the research it cites — F2 says NO open questions in plans, so the honest options are 0 (hard rule) or 1 (escape valve). I chose 1 and my stated reason (agent guessing silently is worse) is a judgment call, not evidence. Flag if you want the hard rule.

threads.Text: [Q] I made Findings min_subsections 2 to force discrete findings — but a small research task might legitimately have one finding. mini exists for small changes; is a small-research escape hatch needed, or is one-finding research just a comment thread instead of a doc?

threads.Text: [Q] Bootstrap note: this plan is written in the shape Phase 2 proposes (it cannot validate against a template that does not exist yet). Phase 2 manual criterion closes the loop by validating this doc against the new template once built.
